title: CSV field picker
prompt: Implement `static string Field(string line, int index)` — return the `index`-th comma-separated field of `line` (0-based), or `""` when the index is out of range. `Field("rice,beans,,oil", 2)` is `""` — empty fields are real fields.

tests.name: basic
tests.hint: Split, index, done — but mind the no-separator case.

tests.name: empty-fields
tests.hint: An empty field is still a field; out-of-range indices yield "" — no throw.
